description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Great UI 提供 52 个可复制粘贴的 React 组件，覆盖轮播、导航菜单、页面过渡与滚动动效等类别，例如 Fluid App Dock、Floating Menu、CrossBlur Page Transition 和 Blur Scroll Reveal。首页说明这些组件基于 Tailwind CSS 构建，可复制、粘贴并自定义后用于应用界面。
description.en: Great UI 提供 52 个可复制粘贴的 React 组件，覆盖轮播、导航菜单、页面过渡与滚动动效等类别，例如 Fluid App Dock、Floating Menu、CrossBlur Page Transition 和 Blur Scroll Reveal。首页说明这些组件基于 Tailwind CSS 构建，可复制、粘贴并自定义后用于应用界面。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Great UI (https://www.great-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, typescript, motion.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
